confirmed: The local source is the journal version of record in Australasian Journal of Educational Technology, 2026, 42(2), 39-59, with 21 PDF pages. The title and all five listed authors match (PDF pp. 1 and 21; journal pp. 39 and 59).

There is one original people experiment. Individual random assignment to ChatGPT versus no ChatGPT is explicit, and controlled classroom sessions support lab_rct and context_class none despite the quasi-experimental title (PDF p. 4, journal p. 42, Procedure; PDF p. 17, journal p. 55, Limitations).

The analyzed sample is 124 people: Experimental N = 60 and Control N = 64. These are students, not solutions or ratings, and the sample exceeds the 50-person threshold (PDF p. 5, journal p. 43, Figure 1; PDF p. 7, journal p. 45, Participants and Table 2).

The paper excludes students who withdrew without collecting their questionnaires, gives no withdrawal count, and says none of the collected questionnaires were excluded. A separate original randomized count is not stated, so n_randomized null is appropriate (PDF p. 4, journal p. 42, Procedure; PDF p. 5, journal p. 43, Figure 1).

Participants were recruited at Yangzhou University in China for credits; Table 2 reports mean age 19.20 in each arm, and sessions contained at most 10 students per arm (PDF p. 4, journal p. 42, Procedure; PDF p. 7, journal p. 45, Table 2).

The screenshot identifies ChatGPT 4o. Participants used one browser tab, received guided prompts and interaction training, and could not change the model; controls used paper and pencil. Interactions were logged (PDF pp. 5-7, journal pp. 43-45, Figures 1-2, Procedure and Table 1).

Four open-ended MCT tasks are described, including drawing 2 cm² figures on a 4 × 4 grid. Experiment duration is reported as 72 minutes (SD = 7) for Experimental and 60 minutes (SD = 5) for Control (PDF p. 8, journal p. 46, MCT; PDF p. 5, journal p. 43, Procedure).

Flexibility, fluency and originality are scored on produced solutions by two independent scorers and aggregated at participant level. They are immediate with_ai outcomes; there is no post-removal creative task or across-people homogenization outcome (PDF pp. 9-11, journal pp. 47-49, scoring and Table 5; PDF p. 5, journal p. 43, Figure 1).

S1-O1 reported statistics match: Experimental M = 15.12, SD = 3.71 versus Control M = 12.50, SD = 3.49; t(122) = 4.05, d = 0.73, p = 0.000; ANCOVA F(1,121) = 16.60, partial eta-squared = 0.12, p < 0.001 (PDF p. 11, journal p. 49, Table 5 and Results H1a-c).

S1-O2 reported statistics match: Experimental M = 29.25, SD = 8.65 versus Control M = 23.73, SD = 8.08; t(122) = 3.67, d = 0.66, p = 0.000; ANCOVA F(1,121) = 13.90, partial eta-squared = 0.10, p < 0.001 (PDF p. 11, journal p. 49, Table 5 and Results H1a-c).

S1-O3 reported statistics match: Experimental M = 4.82, SD = 2.64 versus Control M = 3.78, SD = 2.29; t(122) = 2.34, d = 0.42, p = 0.021; ANCOVA F(1,121) = 5.44, partial eta-squared = 0.04, p = 0.021 (PDF pp. 11-12, journal pp. 49-50, Table 5 and Results H1a-c).

The Table 5 note explicitly labels its p values as Benjamini-Hochberg FDR corrected, and the Data analysis section specifies prior ChatGPT experience as the ANCOVA covariate. All numbers and directions in the one-line finding match Table 5 (PDF p. 11, journal p. 49, Table 5 and note; PDF p. 8, journal p. 46, Data analysis).

Self-efficacy, self-evaluation, interest, difficulty and effort concern participant reports; they do not add output-scored creativity outcomes. The experimental study is not a synthesis, so synthesis defaults are appropriate (PDF pp. 10-14, journal pp. 48-52, Measures and Results).

No preregistration, external data/code URL or shared-sample statement is reported in this document. Author affiliations and funding identify academic/public bodies, with no commercial sponsor reported (PDF p. 1, journal p. 39, affiliations; PDF p. 18, journal p. 56, Funding; full-document review).
summary: The paper reports random assignment to ChatGPT versus paper-and-pencil assistance, with 124 students analyzed, and meets the core criteria for the two-screener pipeline. All reported creativity statistics and the one-line finding match the PDF, but eligibility, page mapping, unsupported degree-level wording, and incomplete supplement, scoring and statistics fields need correction.
